items.body_html: a context block’s body lives only in template.context_blocks; refs are ids, never inline prose — one place to author, dedup, and validate
validate_context_refs(template) runs in CREATE_INSTANCE beside binding coverage and validate_gate_config; an unresolved ref is unresolved_context_block_ref — fail at create, not a render-time drop
role → step → gate, declaration order within each; same instance state + config ⇒ byte-identical context_blocks. Order is reading sequence, not precedence/override
a gate’s block renders only for a transition in available_ops ∩ L1 capability — transition existence plus the L1 role/current_step authority check; never blind step membership
an id reached from several sources renders once; provenance.sources[] keeps every emitter, so the packet stays terse but auditable
context_blocks never enter a verdict or the commit; removing a block cannot change what L2 enforces (correctness is L2’s job, legibility is L2b’s)
